title: GP governance record frontmatter (V4C-29/31/35)
description: Narrow BY RULE (V4C-35): a field may exist here only if a check in scripts/check_records.py consumes it. Prose stays canonical markdown; this validates the frontmatter block only. Adding a field requires naming the concrete failure its absence permits.

id.description: Stable, unique, referenceable. Drives R3 + all cross-record resolution.

status.description: Closed enum with a declared flow; drives X3 ordering (a record may not be ahead of its dependency).

supersedes.description: Drives X1 resolution + X2 cycle detection.

subject_ref.description: Commit SHA the record describes (snapshot binding).

propagation.description: V4C-36: one row per coupled artifact. A row containing `pending` fails the gate.

approvers.description: NON-AUTHORITATIVE: author-written claim, never treated as authorization (Security seat condition).
